name.ja: ハウエラ・ヴィンセンス

displayName.ja: ハウエラ・ヴィンセンス

profile.ja: 対魔族用特殊部隊の一員でシールド甲兵と呼ばれる兵士。重力制御によって分厚い複合装甲を自在に操り戦う。その防御力は折り紙付きで、複合装甲は戦車砲をはじき返し、魔族の瘴気や火といった異能攻撃をも防ぐ。さらに、装甲板を叩き付けて攻撃すれば、その硬さと重量によってオーガすら一撃で絶命させる。本人の性格は自信家でノリが良く、かなりのナルシスト。男女問わずに好かれる完璧超人と自称していて、『自分のファンを守る為に戦う』と公言している。実際、誰に対しても明るく公正に接する彼女は人気者だが、『ファンのために、誰か一人のものになるつもりは無い』と特定のパートナーは作らない。
profile.en: She is a member of the special unit against the demon tribe, known as a Shield Soldier. She manipulates a thick composite armor with gravity control and fights with it. Her defensive power is exceptional, and the composite armor can deflect even tank guns and protect against the demon tribe's miasma and fire, as well as other abnormal attacks. Furthermore, if she attacks by slamming the armor plates, the hardness and weight of the plates can instantly kill even an Ogre. She is confident, has a good sense of humor, and is a considerable narcissist. She claims to be a perfect superhuman who is liked by both men and women, and she publicly states that she fights to protect her fans. In reality, she is a popular person who treats everyone brightly and fairly, but she does not intend to become someone's partner for the sake of her fans.

text.ja: やぁ隊長、はじめまして。ハウエラ・ヴィンセンスだ――よろしく頼むよ。万事、ボクに任せておきたまえ！
text.en: Hey, Captain, nice to meet you. I'm Hawera Vincennes - I'm looking forward to working with you. Leave everything to me, okay?

text.ja: そう心配しなくていい。ボクが同行するのだから、失敗はあり得ないよ。大船に乗ったつもりで――というやつだね
text.en: Don't worry about it. Since I'm with you, failure is not an option. It's like being on a large ship, you know?

text.ja: 一人でも多くのファンを守るため、ボクは戦うんだよ――ファンなんているのかって？　これほど美しいボクに対して、愚問だね
text.en: I fight to protect as many fans as I can - do you think I don't have any fans? That's a ridiculous question, considering how beautiful I am.

text.ja: おっと危ない――無事かな？　これは複合装甲といって、あらゆる攻撃に対応できる装甲さ。扱いは難しいが、武器にもなる優秀なシールドだよ
text.en: Whoa, that was close - are you okay? This is a composite armor that can handle any attack. It's difficult to use, but it's an excellent shield that can also be used as a weapon.

text.ja: 特定の恋人はいないよ。ボクにとっては、ファンすべてが特別な存在だからね――誰か一人のモノにはなれないんだ、いくら隊長が相手でもね
text.en: I don't have a specific lover. To me, all my fans are special, so I couldn't possibly belong to just one person - not even if you're my Captain.

text.ja: 出向扱いだなんて、言わないでおくれよ……同じチームにいる以上、ボクらは仲間なのだからね
text.en: Don't say that we're just temporary teammates... as long as we're on the same team, we're comrades, after all.

text.ja: っ……無事、だったかな……？　なに、こんなのは掠り傷さ……キミを守れたなら、それでいいさ
text.en: I-I hope you're okay... it's nothing, just a scratch. As long as I can protect you, that's all that matters.

text.ja: さぁ、行こう！　大丈夫、なにがあろうとボクが守るからね――
text.en: Alright, let's go! Don't worry, I'll protect you no matter what happens.

text.ja: っ、こんな所、ファンの皆に見られたら……はぁっ、くはぁ……！　や、やめてだなんて、言ってないだろ？　もっと、ちょうだい♪
text.en: I-If my fans saw me like this... Haa, kuu...! You're not telling me to stop, are you? I want more, please.

text.ja: 意地悪なこと、言わないでおくれよ。今は皆のハウエラ・ヴィンセンスじゃなくて、ただの一人の女の子さ。ボクのことも、ハニーって呼んで……
text.en: Don't be mean to me, okay? Right now, I'm not Hawera Vincennes, the hero of the fans - I'm just a normal girl. Call me Honey, and treat me like you would any other girl.

text.ja: あぁぁ♪　ダメだと分かってるのに、君の前だと欲望を抑えきれないんだ。疼いて、濡れて、たまらない……。ボク以上に罪作りな人だよ、君は
text.en: Ahhh... even though I know it's wrong, I just can't help myself when I'm around you. I'm burning with desire, I'm wet, and I just can't take it. You're the one who's making me feel this way, you're the one who's tempting me.
